Cassette 1.7 reduces memory and CPU use when saving playback state and reduces the size of the bundled playback tools.

- Local Songs and playback saves share track storage. Library edits preserve saved snapshots, and existing library files still load in the same format.
- Cover downloads share a connection pool. Startup and Recap find the five highest-ranked songs without sorting the entire listening history.
- The bundled playback tools use stronger compression with the same decoder memory limit. The macOS disk image also uses stronger compression.

Downloads are available for Windows x64, macOS Apple Silicon, and Linux x64. All packages include yt-dlp and QuickJS-NG.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/ctrlcat0x/Cassette/compare/v1.6.0...v1.7.0)
